title: Repertoire of the Young shows in 1926
summary: Phillips says everyone played the same tunes, such as I Love My Baby and Five Foot Two.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Yeah. You saw that on that little picture that I gave you.
Before you get into that, is there anything else you want to say about that last show you did with Mrs. Young? Anything about the music? What kind of music were they doing at that time?
The same kind as in the vaudeville shows? The same kind as in the minstrel show?
Yeah, the same... Everybody was doing the same thing. "I Love My Baby" and "Baby Won't You Please Come Home?" and "Five Foot Two and Eyes of Blue" and... "I Never Knew."
Which "I Never Knew" was that? There were two of them.
The one "I never knew I could love anybody, honey, like I'm lovin' you..."
The other one Lester used to do a lot later on.
Well, that wasn't quite out then.
